error_summary: vLLM rejected disabling chunked prefill with max_model_len=32768 and max_num_batched_tokens=8192 because max_num_batched_tokens must be at least max_model_len when chunked prefill is disabled.
exact_error: Value error, max_num_batched_tokens (8192) is smaller than max_model_len (32768). This effectively limits the maximum sequence length to max_num_batched_tokens and makes vLLM reject longer sequences. Please increase max_num_batched_tokens or decrease max_model_len.
decision: Not tested further in this run. A valid 32k no-chunk screen would require max_num_batched_tokens=32768 or a smaller max_model_len, which changes memory/concurrency tradeoffs and needs a separate startup/memory gate.
